verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a shared-inbox and email-collaboration product, so the axis applies. The pack documents no first-party bulk export of all data in open formats. The REST API endpoints for conversations, contacts and drafts, the MCP server, local attachment downloads and two-way Gmail sync are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not an export capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
